execution.cost_disposition: Six complete unchanged-fixture samples establish bounded functional execution. Candidate medians63.134s/70.923s are13.46%/27.46% above fastest55.643s and13.00%/26.94% above pooled55.870s; not a latency improvement. Immutable baseline itself has55/55/95s medians; no slow-reference selection or range-overlap automatic pass. Event counts are identical, so extra tasks/events do not explain cost. Stronger/richer representation, freshness and integrity work are real feature costs elsewhere, but no per-phase CPU/IO proof attributes these execution deltas. No concrete correctness or deadline violation is demonstrated. Conditional recommendation: retain as explicit bounded supported-use cost with unknown timing attribution, subject to final independent acceptance; never claim causal no-regression/universalquietness.
execution.quietness: One owned workload at a time is recorded; unrelated machine activity was not measured or controlled. timing_qualified is capture-mode qualification, not independently verified host idleness.

memory.disposition: Accept explicit supported-use tradeoff underM03/G05: bounded progressive disclosure reduces returned data and logical source reads, preserves all declared complete-answer witnesses and history, but pays two source-symbol refreshes and is slower to complete than fullrediscovery. Direct-ID first durable fact is faster and requires fewer memory reads/zero refreshes; it has a narrower memory-only answer witness and restart total can still be higher. Scheduler fixture records source reads during SDK/bootstrap despite the memory-only answer, so no universal zero-source-I/O claim. These are same-current workflows, not a release-baseline speed comparison. No token/cost/live-provider success metrics exist.
